label: Expected binary epistemic squared error: Error=q*^2+*r^2 on real inputs
definition: error(q,r)=q*(1-r)^2+(1-q)*r^2 on real inputs. In probability applications q and r are in [0,1]. Within(q,c,epsilon) bounds q-c above and below by epsilon. q is an independently warranted assessment if so applied, not defined as truth or calibration. The theorem supplies no normative predicate. pairError scores the two complementary credences by (1-r)^2+s^2 when p is true and r^2+(1-s)^2 otherwise. Projection uses ((1+r-s)/2,(1-r+s)/2). This statewise summed-error comparison needs no q.
